# Search corpus

- `queries.json` — 54 queries (Chinese / English / mixed / special / empty /
  long / pagination boundaries), executed in order.
- `results/` — one JSON file per query, generated by
  `./scripts/capture_search.sh` against `go-baseline-2026-11` and committed.
  52 queries returned 200, `edge_empty` returned 400, and `special_01` (`"`)
  returned 500 `Search failed`.
- `results_index.json` — ordered summary (`total`, `list_length`, status).

Two consecutive captures diffed clean, so the results are reproducible.

## Result shape

```json
{
  "id": "zh_01",
  "kind": "chinese",
  "keyword": "文章",
  "page": 1,
  "page_size": 10,
  "status": 200,
  "total": 5,
  "list_length": 5,
  "slugs": ["published-post", "..."],
  "body": {"list": [], "total": 5, "page": 1}
}
```

`body` is normalized (timestamps → `<timestamp>`), so the Rust/tantivy tests can
compare directly.

## Acceptance (Phase 5)

- top-10 slug overlap ≥ 95% vs Go for the Chinese/English/mixed corpus
- `total` difference ≤ 1, ignoring intentional fixes (draft/hidden/is_deleted leaks)
- draft/hidden/is_deleted posts must not appear (Q1/Q2/Q2b)
- pagination boundaries match (including `page_size=0` / invalid page)
